question: Can open OCR read Pakistani doctors' handwriting?
dataset: 86 labelled samples, 30 doctors, Nawabshah — 50 resolve to catalogue drugs

attempts.note: 0/15. Trained on IAM prose; hallucinates fluent English phrases instead of drug names

conclusion: No off-the-shelf open OCR reads this handwriting. Printed slips work perfectly (100%). Closing the handwriting gap needs either a model fine-tuned on this dataset, or a vision-language model API.
mitigation: Every scanned line is confirmed by the patient with its confidence shown; typing a brand name is a first-class path and matches reliably.
